bio.text: Mia Bonta, a Democrat, represents the 18th Assembly District, which covers part of Alameda County, in the California State Assembly.

Her official website says she was elected in a special election on August 31, 2021, previously served as CEO of Oakland Promise, and was elected to the Alameda Unified School District board in 2018, serving as its president from 2018 to 2021.
According to the same page, she holds a B.A. from Yale University, an Ed.M. from Harvard Graduate School of Education and a J.D. from Yale Law School, and lives in Alameda.
